title_sq: OKAZION!!! Ndertese 4-Kateshe ne Shitje ne Don Bosko prane Kompleksit Vizion ne Tirane (ID 4151064 )

title_en: BARGAIN!!! 4-Storey Building for Sale in Don Bosco near Vizion Complex in Tirana (ID 4151064)
description_en: 4-storey building for sale, Don Bosco street, 200 m² away from the ring road. Total Area 572.9 m² (ground floor 250 m², ground floor 125 m², and 3 residential floors with an area of ​​149.3 m² each). The villa is invested, has a regular layout. The 1st floor is organized in: garage together with 1 toilet. The 2nd floor is organized in: Kitchen with exit to the balcony, 3 bedrooms each with 1 toilet (with window), one of the rooms also has an exit to the balcony. The 3rd floor is organized in: Living room totally invested, with parquet, LED lighting. 3 bedrooms (floored with parquet) each with 1 toilet (all toilets have windows). The 4th floor has the same floor plan as the 3rd floor. The property has regular documents, Building Permit and Certificate of Ownership. It is also very suitable for business. FOR SALE 660,000 Euros
